# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Use AGENTS.md as the canonical project instruction file.

Always inspect:
- docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/PLATFORM_CONSTRAINTS.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- state/CURRENT.md

Keep integrations replaceable and do not add job-application automation that bypasses platform rules or anti-bot controls.

Do not invent candidate facts.
